a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to run the generator up to 8 almost certainly ends with us both dead. Reaching 8 takes 2 rounds, and our odds of getting there are only about 4%. So I'm going to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather, operate and I'll help refill afterward if we get more rounds.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. If we survive the storm, I'll operate every round after this to help rebuild the reserve for you, and I'll give back any cells beyond 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
